svg.title: Open Source Metro mobile / SYNTHETIC DESIGN SHOWCASE
svg.desc: A dedicated portrait view of the most recent sixteen Sunday-to-Saturday weeks. Date squares show observed source-event units; each line is one active repository, with stops only on observed weeks. Ring stations denote merged pull requests and diamond stations denote releases. The rail between stops is schematic, not continuous activity. Blank means unobserved, not zero GitHub contributions. This is not the official GitHub contributions chart.

g.text: A recent snapshot of project journeys
